probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Go to homepage Navy Integrations Customers Pricing Changelog Blog Overview Sign in Buy Navy Go to homepage Navy /// Menu Integrations Customers Pricing Changelog Blog Overview Status Help center Sign in Buy Navy The people who hold the pager Navy is built by a small remote team of engineers and designers who have all been on call. Here are some of them. Read our story Co-founder and CEO Maya Lombardi She started the company with one goal: alerts that engineers can trust, and status pages that tell customers the truth. Co-founder and CTO Marco Bianchi He designed the check network that runs monitors every 30 seconds from 18 regions, and the confirmation model that waits for 3 regions to agree before anyone gets alerted. Product Engineer Carmen Vidal She built the Terraform provider, the Navy CLI and the validation that catches config mistakes before they reach production. Head of Design Ingrid Solberg She shaped the dashboard, the status page themes and the alert messages that land on phones at 3 a.m., where every word has to be clear on the first read.
